title.en: Comments and transcripts, ready for your recap
title.zh: 把留言與字幕，整理成有來源的回顧

description.en: Find the original comments, work with your AI assistant on a recap, and keep a draft with citations. Try the local example without an account.
description.zh: 找到原始留言，與你的 AI 助理一起寫回顧，再把草稿與引用一起留下。先跑本地範例，不需要帳號。

eyebrow.zh: 從下一份活動回顧開始

headline.en: Turn comments into a recap with sources.
headline.zh: 把留言與字幕，整理成有來源的回顧。

lede.en: Have event feedback to review or a transcript to quote? Your AI assistant helps you make sense of it. MetaMuse keeps the originals, finds matching passages, and saves your draft with its citations.
lede.zh: 活動後的留言想整理？影片裡的一段話想引用？讓你慣用的 AI 助理幫忙判讀與撰寫，MetaMuse 負責保存原文、搜尋段落，把草稿與引用一起留下。

label.en: Read the getting started guide (中文)

notes.en: No account needed for the example

meta.zh: 合成資料示範 · 預寫回顧

label.en: Import a post and two comments
label.zh: 匯入一則貼文與兩則留言

label.en: Find the request for video subtitles
label.zh: 找到「希望影片加上字幕」的留言

label.en: Keep the original comment as a citation
label.zh: 保留原始留言作為引用

label.en: Open the recap as a Markdown file
label.zh: 打開 Markdown，閱讀回顧與來源

right.en: No AI call in this example

title.en: The event is over. The feedback is still scattered.
title.zh: 活動結束了，留言與影片還散在各處。

body.en: You want to know what people asked for, find a useful quote, and write a recap you can stand behind. Give your assistant permitted comments or local subtitles. MetaMuse keeps those sources available so you can check a draft against the original words.
body.zh: 想知道大家提了哪些需求、找出一段值得引用的話，再寫成一份能核對的回顧。把你有權使用的留言或本地字幕交給助理整理，MetaMuse 留下來源，讓你隨時回頭確認原文。

kicker.en: From input to a file you can keep
kicker.zh: 從資料到一份可保存的文件

title.en: Bring the comments. Leave with a sourced draft.
title.zh: 帶入留言，帶走有來源的草稿。

intro.en: You can use the terminal directly, or connect an AI assistant that can run MetaMuse tools.
intro.zh: 你可以直接使用終端機，也可以接上能操作 MetaMuse 工具的 AI 助理。

title.zh: 匯入資料

body.en: Import permitted local comments, text or SRT/VTT subtitles into a project.
body.zh: 將有權使用的本地留言、文字或 SRT/VTT 字幕匯入專案。

title.zh: 找到原文

body.en: Search for a word such as subtitles. Open the matching text and its source reference.
body.zh: 例如搜尋「字幕」，查看命中的原文與來源引用。

title.zh: 一起寫回顧

body.en: Your assistant groups requests and writes. Save the draft with the sources you reviewed.
body.zh: 由你的 AI 助理分組、判讀與撰寫，再連同你核對過的引用保存草稿。

title.zh: 閱讀並留下

body.en: Preview the draft and export Markdown or another local format. Check the wording against the cited material.
body.zh: 預覽草稿，匯出 Markdown 等本地格式，對照引用確認文字是否忠實。

title.en: Less hunting for the original. More time for the recap.
title.zh: 少一點翻找原文，多一點時間整理重點。

intro.en: Start with local files. Add an assistant when you want help interpreting and writing.
intro.zh: 先從本地檔案開始，需要判讀與撰寫時，再交給你的 AI 助理協助。

title.zh: 整理活動回饋

body.en: Find comments about the next event, accessibility requests or missing materials. Your assistant can turn the selected evidence into a recap.
body.zh: 找出對下一場活動的建議、無障礙需求或索取講義的留言，再讓助理依選好的原文寫回顧。

title.zh: 找回字幕段落

body.en: Import local SRT or VTT files and search for the words you want to quote.
body.zh: 匯入本地 SRT 或 VTT 字幕，用關鍵字找出想引用的段落。

title.en: Check where a claim came from
title.zh: 核對一句話的來源

body.en: Keep source references and exact text revisions alongside a draft, so you can compare the wording with the original.
body.zh: 將來源引用與原文版本連同草稿保存，需要時可以對照文字。

title.zh: 接上慣用的 AI 助理

body.en: Connect through CLI or MCP. The assistant asks questions and writes; MetaMuse handles the local records.
body.zh: 透過 CLI 或 MCP 連接。助理負責提問與撰寫，MetaMuse 負責保存本地資料。

title.zh: 選擇向 Muse 追問

body.en: Muse is optional and needs separate setup and human approval. Real-account use is still awaiting LIVE verification.
body.zh: Muse 是可選的協作者，需要另外設定及人類授權。真實帳號使用仍待 LIVE 驗證。

title.en: Keep a file you can use
title.zh: 留下能接著使用的文件

body.en: Export Markdown, text, CSV, JSONL or a bundle for your own review and editing. Publishing is not implemented.
body.zh: 匯出 Markdown、文字、CSV、JSONL 或資料套件，方便後續閱讀與編輯。目前尚未提供發布功能。

title.en: Search, draft, export. In the real CLI.
title.zh: 搜尋、草稿、匯出，實際畫面在這裡。

intro.en: These are real terminal captures from a separate synthetic walkthrough, including fixture Muse replies. Each image links to a readable transcript. They demonstrate the workflow, not real-account results.
intro.zh: 這些是真實終端機截圖，來自另一份包含 fixture Muse 回覆的合成資料範例。每張都有純文字紀錄可閱讀，用來展示流程，不代表真實帳號的執行結果。

alt.en: Search hit with an exact item revision, Chinese snippet and source labels.
alt.zh: 搜尋命中包含精確項目版本、中文片段與來源標籤。

caption.en: One hit cites its exact item revision. Its source labels remain file_import and synthetic_fixture. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 一筆命中引用精確項目版本。來源標籤維持 file_import 與 synthetic_fixture。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Host-written draft citing the item and two Muse observations
alt.zh: 主代理草稿引用項目與兩筆 Muse 觀察

caption.en: The host saves its own text with the item revision and observations from both fixture exchanges. No generation call. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 主代理保存自行撰寫的文字，引用項目版本與兩輪 fixture 討論的觀察。沒有呼叫生成模型。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Local bundle manifest, fixture labels and no-publication warnings
alt.zh: 本地套件清單、fixture 標記與未發布警告

caption.en: The local bundle manifest lists file hashes and retains the fixture labels. Stderr says nothing was published or uploaded, and redaction is a guard. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 本地套件清單列出檔案雜湊並保留 fixture 標記。stderr 寫明沒有發布或上傳，遮蔽只是一道防護。閱讀純文字紀錄。

title.en: Your assistant writes. You can check the sources.
title.zh: 助理幫你寫，你查得到來源。

intro.en: Install MetaMuse locally, then give an assistant access through CLI or MCP. The Skill explains how to use the connected tools.
intro.zh: 先在本地安裝 MetaMuse，再讓助理透過 CLI 或 MCP 使用工具。Skill 提供已連接工具的操作說明。

title.zh: 幾個你可能想問的問題。

intro.en: The first example uses local synthetic files, so you can see the result before connecting accounts or an assistant.
intro.zh: 第一個範例只用本地合成檔案，先看到結果，再決定是否連接帳號或 AI 助理。

title.en: Do I need a Muse account?
title.zh: 一定要有 Muse 帳號嗎？

body.en: No account is needed for local import, search, drafts or exports. Muse is a separately configured, optional discussion partner.
body.zh: 本地匯入、搜尋、草稿與匯出不需要帳號。Muse 是需要另外設定的選用討論對象。

title.en: Will the example write with AI?
title.zh: 範例會直接用 AI 寫回顧嗎？

body.en: It saves a clearly labelled prewritten recap. For your own work, connect an AI assistant or provide the text yourself.
body.zh: 範例保存的是清楚標記的預寫回顧。處理自己的資料時，可以連接 AI 助理，或自行提供文字。

title.en: Can I paste a Facebook or video URL?
title.zh: 可以直接貼 Facebook 或影片網址嗎？

body.en: Remote collectors need their own setup and operator approval. They currently have synthetic tests, with real-account LIVE validation pending. Start with local files.
body.zh: 遠端收集需要各自的設定與操作者授權。目前已有合成資料測試，真實帳號 LIVE 驗證仍待完成。建議先從本地檔案開始。

title.zh: 這是網頁版工具嗎？

body.en: This page introduces a tool that runs on your computer through a terminal or a connected AI assistant. The source preview can be installed today; a packaged release is not published yet.
body.zh: 這裡是介紹頁。工具在你的電腦上，透過終端機或已連接的 AI 助理操作。目前可從原始碼安裝預覽版，尚未發布套件。

title.zh: 打開你的第一份有來源回顧。

intro.en: You need Git and uv. Install from source; uv manages Python 3.12. Installation downloads dependencies. The example then uses only local synthetic data and a prewritten recap, with no account or AI service.
intro.zh: 需要先安裝 Git 與 uv。目前從原始碼安裝，由 uv 管理 Python 3.12。安裝時會下載依賴；之後的範例只用本地合成資料與預寫回顧，不需要帳號或 AI 服務。

title.zh: 下載專案

body.en: Open a terminal and run these commands in order.
body.zh: 打開終端機，依序執行這些指令。

title.zh: 安裝

body.en: uv installs Python and the locked dependencies.
body.zh: uv 會安裝 Python 與固定版本的依賴。

title.zh: 跑範例，看結果

body.en: Import comments, find the subtitle request and export Markdown. Open the .md files in the printed Export directory. Each run keeps a new workspace outside the checkout.
body.zh: 匯入留言、找到字幕需求並匯出 Markdown。打開終端機顯示的 Export directory 裡的 .md 檔。每次執行都會在專案目錄之外保留獨立的新工作區。

title.en: Start locally. Check the integration limits.
title.zh: 先用本地流程，再看整合範圍。

intro.en: Local import, search, drafts and exports have offline tests. Muse LIVE is not verified. Remote collection also awaits real-account LIVE verification. This source preview has no packaged release yet. Details below match the README.
intro.zh: 本地匯入、搜尋、草稿與匯出已有離線測試。Muse 與遠端收集有合成資料測試，真實帳號 LIVE 驗證仍待完成。目前是原始碼預覽版，尚未發布套件。以下細節與 README 保持一致。

works.en:
Local import
implemented with offline tests
Local files and text. The local import path rejects URLs before a job exists; approved remote inputs use their own collector.
works.zh:
本地匯入
implemented with offline tests
本地檔案與文字。本地匯入路徑會在建立工作前拒絕 URL；已核准的遠端輸入使用各自的收集流程。

works.en:
Local media and subtitles
implemented with offline tests
Optional ffprobe; tests requiring it skip when absent.
works.zh:
本地影音與字幕
implemented with offline tests
ffprobe 為選用；缺少執行檔時，相關測試會跳過。

works.en:
Search
implemented with offline tests
Project-scoped search over imported evidence.
works.zh:
搜尋
implemented with offline tests
在專案範圍內搜尋匯入的證據。

works.en:
Packets
implemented with offline tests
Selection file to an exact pre-share preview.
works.zh:
資料包
implemented with offline tests
由選取檔產生精確的分享前預覽。

works.en:
Drafts
implemented with offline tests
Host-supplied text; no generation call.
works.zh:
草稿
implemented with offline tests
主代理提供文字；不呼叫生成模型。

works.en:
Exports
implemented with offline tests
Five local formats; no publish or upload.
works.zh:
匯出
implemented with offline tests
五種本地格式；不發布、不上傳。

works.en:
Muse lifecycle with the fixture backend
implemented with offline tests
Open, send, read and close offline; derived records retain backend=fixture, mock=true, research_complete=false.
works.zh:
fixture 後端的 Muse 流程
implemented with offline tests
離線開啟、送出、讀取與結束；衍生紀錄保留 backend=fixture、mock=true、research_complete=false。

works.en:
Muse standard-VM transport
implemented with offline tests
Strict Noise key/nonce verification, durable trust and bounded wake/redial. AT-038 and AT-043 LIVE have not run; CVM is unsupported.
works.zh:
Muse 標準 VM 傳輸
implemented with offline tests
嚴格驗證 Noise 金鑰與 nonce、持久化信任紀錄，並有界喚醒與重連。AT-038、AT-043 尚未執行 LIVE；不支援 CVM。

works.en:
MCP stdio
implemented with offline tests
Fifteen tools; stdout is protocol, logs go to stderr.
works.zh:
MCP stdio
implemented with offline tests
15 個工具；stdout 僅傳協定，日誌送至 stderr。

works.en:
MCP attached worker
implemented with offline tests
metamuse mcp starts one worker; --no-worker opts out. One workspace executor holds the OS lock.
works.zh:
MCP 附掛 worker
implemented with offline tests
metamuse mcp 啟動一個 worker；--no-worker 可停用。同一工作區只有一個執行者持有 OS 鎖。

works.en:
Approval previews and metamuse permit approve
implemented with offline tests
Human approval of the exact action; no MCP approval tool.
works.zh:
核准預覽與 metamuse permit approve
implemented with offline tests
人類核准精確操作；MCP 沒有核准工具。

works.en:
Remote media (B12)
implemented with offline tests
Exact-action approval preview and human permit approve. OFFLINE and FIXTURE evidence; AT-040 LIVE has not been run.
works.zh:
遠端影音（B12）
implemented with offline tests
精確操作的核准預覽與人類執行的 permit approve。已有 OFFLINE 與 FIXTURE 證據；尚未執行 AT-040 LIVE。

works.en:
Facebook posts (B13)
implemented with offline tests
One operator-approved post per job, rendered in sandboxed Chromium through a policy-checked local proxy. Tested only on synthetic loopback pages; requires the facebook extra and Playwright Chromium. Human approval uses metamuse permit create; Facebook approval preview is not wired yet. No real-account run.
works.zh:
Facebook 貼文（B13）
implemented with offline tests
每個工作限一則操作者核准的貼文，以沙盒 Chromium 經過本地政策檢查代理呈現。僅以合成的本機回環頁面測試；需要 facebook 選用依賴與 Playwright Chromium。由人類執行 metamuse permit create 核准；Facebook 核准預覽流程尚未接上。未曾使用真實帳號執行。

works.en:
CI
implemented with offline tests
GitHub Actions check runs the offline gates, sandboxed loopback Chromium browser tests (browser skips fail CI), and wheel smoke on every PR and main push; required status check on main since 2026-10-14.
works.zh:
CI
implemented with offline tests
GitHub Actions check 在每個 PR 與 main push 執行離線檢查、沙盒 Chromium 本機回環瀏覽器測試（跳過瀏覽器測試即失敗）及 wheel smoke；自 2026-10-14 起為 main 的必要狀態檢查。
